heading: Our Turnkey Process

sections.title: Make Your Home or Agriturismo Sustainable in Weeks

items.title: Contact Us
items.text: Contact us by phone, email or through the website. We will ask for some basic information about your property, such as recent energy bills, the address, photos of the building and details of your existing energy systems.

items.title: Initial Video Consultation
items.text: We will review the information you provide and discuss your property, current energy system, objectives and any initial questions about solar PV, heat pumps or the installation process.

items.title: Remote Feasibility Analysis
items.text: We carry out an initial feasibility analysis based on the location, Comune, available space, existing energy systems and other relevant characteristics of your property.

items.title: Site Visit
items.text: We schedule a three-hour site visit to collect the technical information required to design the appropriate solar PV and heat pump solution for your property.

items.title: Tailored Solution & Fixed-Price Proposal
items.text: We develop a detailed solution tailored to your property and provide a clear, fixed-price proposal. Once you accept the offer, we prepare the detailed implementation plan and installation schedule.

items.title: High-Quality Installation
items.text: We install the integrated solar PV and heat pump system with a focus on quality, reliability and minimal disruption to your home or agriturismo.

items.title: Turnkey Handoff
items.text: We hand over the finished system, a fully implemented turnkey solution tailored to your property.

items.title: Support
items.text: Post-installation support as needed and requested by you.

availability.title: Available Hours
lines: By phone: Every day from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
